lines.text: Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
Praise Him for His mighty acts;
praise Him for His excellent greatness.
Praise Him with the sound of the horn;
praise Him with the harp and lyre.
Praise Him with tambourine and dancing;
praise Him with strings and flute.
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!

pictures.scene: Jacques Emile Edouard Brandon, Scene in a Synagogue - a man in a gold prayer shawl lifting the Torah scroll high before a congregation in black hats while a boy carries the candles, the Hallelujah that opens the psalm and the call to praise God in His sanctuary
pictures.name: pd_brandon_scene_in_a_synagogue

pictures.scene: Cornelis Lieste, Avondstemming met herder - a vast luminous evening sky over tall windswept pines, a shepherd resting beside a stony stream with his sheep grazing round him, praise Him in His mighty heavens
pictures.name: pd_lieste_avondstemming_met_herder

pictures.scene: Annibale Carracci, Holy Women at Christ's Tomb - the winged angel in white seated on the rolled-back tomb slab as the holy women come up with their jar of ointment, praise Him for His mighty acts and praise Him for His excellent greatness
pictures.name: pd_carracci_holy_women_at_christs_tomb

pictures.scene: Jan Miense Molenaer, Lady at the virginal - a young woman in black and rose silk playing an open virginal with its strings and painted lid showing, two children leaning over the instrument to listen, praise Him with the sound of the horn, praise Him with the harp and lyre
pictures.name: pd_molenaer_lady_at_the_virginal

pictures.scene: John Singer Sargent, Capri - a woman in a pink skirt dancing the tarantella on a sunlit white rooftop while another sits beating a tambourine for her, praise Him with tambourine and dancing, praise Him with strings and flute
pictures.name: pd_sargent_capri

pictures.scene: Marius Bauer, Oosterse bruiloft - a wedding procession crowding under a great arch, the bride high on a camel, a child dancing and a piper playing ahead of her, praise Him with clashing cymbals, praise Him with resounding cymbals
pictures.name: pd_bauer_oosterse_bruiloft

pictures.scene: Nicolaes Pieterszoon Berchem, Het ponteveer - a girl on a white horse among drovers, cattle, sheep, goats and a running dog at a river ferry crossing, birds turning in a wide cumulus sky above them, let everything that has breath praise the LORD
pictures.name: pd_berchem_het_ponteveer
